加形容词后缀 -ical 构成，义为「病理的；病态的」
再加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「病理上」
加希腊语词根 phyto-（植物）构成，义为「植物病理学」
加词根 neuro-（神经）构成，义为「神经病理学」

senses.title: The study of disease
senses.definition: the branch of medicine that studies the nature, causes, and effects of disease
senses.definitionCN: 研究疾病本质、成因与影响的医学分支
senses.example: She chose to specialise in pathology after medical school.
senses.exampleCN: 医学院毕业后，她选择专攻病理学。
senses.why: The -logy part means the study of, so pathology names the science that follows disease through the body.
senses.whyCN: -logy 表示「学问」，所以 pathology 指的是追踪疾病在身体中如何发展的学科。

senses.title: A diseased condition in the body
senses.definition: the changes in organs or tissues that a disease causes
senses.definitionCN: 疾病在器官或组织中造成的改变
senses.example: The scan showed a pathology in the left lung.
senses.exampleCN: 扫描显示左肺有病变。
senses.why: Because disease leaves visible marks, the name of the study is used for the marks themselves.
senses.whyCN: 疾病会留下可见的痕迹，于是学科名被直接用来指这些痕迹，即「病变」。

senses.title: The medical nature of a disease
senses.definition: the particular nature, cause, and progress of a disease in one patient
senses.definitionCN: 某一病人所患疾病的具体性质、成因与发展
senses.example: The doctors disagreed about the pathology of the illness.
senses.exampleCN: 医生们对这场病的病理意见不一。
senses.why: Clinical use asks what is wrong and why, and pathology supplies that description of cause and course.
senses.whyCN: 临床要问「哪里不对、为什么」，病理学正是提供病因与病程描述的学问。

senses.title: Diseased behaviour used as a metaphor
senses.definition: a serious fault in a society or system, seen as if it were a disease
senses.definitionCN: 把社会或制度中的严重问题视为一种疾病
senses.example: The article studies the pathology of the housing market.
senses.exampleCN: 文章研究了住房市场存在的病症。
senses.why: If a body can be diseased, so can a system, which gives the word its figurative reach.
senses.whyCN: 既然身体会生病，制度也会，于是这个词获得了比喻性的延伸。

senses.title: The symptoms and signs of a disease
senses.definition: the observable symptoms and physical signs of a disease
senses.definitionCN: 可观察到的疾病症状与体征
senses.example: Speech pathology treats the symptoms of a voice disorder.
senses.exampleCN: 言语病理学治疗嗓音障碍的症状。
senses.why: When the marks of disease become what is observed and treated, pathology covers symptoms too.
senses.whyCN: 当疾病留下的痕迹本身成为观察与治疗的对象时，pathology 也涵盖症状。

intro.en: Pathology is a compound of Greek pathos, suffering, and the suffix -logia, which names a field of study.
intro.cn: pathology 是希腊语 pathos（痛苦）与表示「学问」的后缀 -logia 的复合。

items.en: Pathos means what a person suffers, and the related word pathe means diseases.
items.cn: pathos 意为「人所遭受的痛苦」，相关词形 pathe 意为「疾病」。

items.en: Ancient medical writers such as Galen describe branch studies of disease, though not yet under this word.
items.cn: 一般认为，盖伦等古代医学作者描述了疾病的分支研究，但尚未使用这个词。

items.en: Pathologia appears in Renaissance Latin medical writing as the study of diseases.
items.cn: pathologia 出现在文艺复兴时期的拉丁语医学文献中，意为「疾病之学」。

items.en: French pathologie is used widely around 1750 for the science of disease.
items.cn: 一般认为，法语 pathologie 在十八世纪中叶被广泛用于指「疾病之科学」。

items.en: English early uses tie pathology to the description of the nature of diseases.
items.cn: 英语早期用它指「对疾病性质的描述」。

items.en: Modern medicine adds cellular and forensic pathology and uses the word for lesions themselves.
items.cn: 现代医学增加了细胞病理学与法医病理学，并用此词直接指「病变」。

note.en: Pathology is the field named by the -logy ending, and lives beside its person pathologist and its adjective pathological.
note.cn: pathology 是以 -logy 结尾的学科名，与指人的 pathologist、指性质的 pathological 同处一族。

entries.definition: a germ that causes disease
entries.definitionCN: 病原体；致病菌

entries.definition: the study of the early church writers
entries.definitionCN: 教父学（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: the study of drugs
entries.definitionCN: 药理学（-logy 同构，词根不同）

entries.definition: the science and practice of treating disease
entries.definitionCN: 医学

entries.definition: the study of the causes of disease
entries.definitionCN: 病因学

entries.definition: an illness of the body
entries.definitionCN: 疾病

normalIntro.en: Pathology is read as patho- for disease plus -logy for the study of, the pattern shared by biology and psychology.
normalIntro.cn: pathology 读作 patho-（疾病）加 -logy（学问），与 biology、psychology 的模式相同。

normal.en: Greek pathos means suffering, which gives the disease part patho-.
normal.cn: 希腊语 pathos 意为痛苦，由此产生表示疾病的 patho-。

normal.en: The suffix -logy marks a study, as in biology and psychology.
normal.cn: 后缀 -logy 标记一门学问，如 biology 与 psychology。

normal.en: Pathology and pathologist pair the field with the person, like biology and biologist.
normal.cn: pathology 与 pathologist 一学一人，正如 biology 与 biologist。

normal.en: Forensic pathology answers how a person died; plant pathology answers how a crop fell ill.
normal.cn: forensic pathology 回答「人是怎么死的」，plant pathology 回答「庄稼是怎么病的」。

normal.en: Compare pathology with disease: pathology is the study or the change, disease is the illness a patient feels.
normal.cn: 对比 pathology 与 disease：前者是学科或病变，后者是病人所患的疾病。

abstract.en: Picture a map of the body with one organ circled in red ink.
abstract.cn: 想象一张人体图，某个器官被红笔圈出。

abstract.en: Imagine a file labelled by illness instead of by name, and inside someone studies how it spreads.
abstract.cn: 想象一个按病症而非人名归档的档案，里面有人研究它的扩散方式。

abstract.en: Think of a city with blocked pipes, and someone writing a report on what went wrong.
abstract.cn: 想象一座管道堵塞的城市，有人正在写一份关于哪里出错的报告。

examples.en: She teaches pathology at a large teaching hospital.
examples.cn: 她在一所大型教学医院教授病理学。

examples.en: The autopsy revealed the pathology behind the sudden death.
examples.cn: 尸检揭示了这次猝死背后的病变。

examples.en: Researchers publish work on the pathology of the disease in leading journals.
examples.cn: 研究人员在顶级期刊上发表关于该病病理的成果。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「怕死」＋「了记」——怕死，就把病症都记下来研究；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 pathos（痛苦、疾病）＋ -logia（学问）→ 新拉丁语 pathologia → 法语 pathologie → 英语 pathology，核心义「研究疾病之学」及「病留下的痕迹」。

sensesIntro.en: Pathology starts as the science of disease, then names the changes disease leaves, then the course of an illness, and finally any serious social fault.
sensesIntro.cn: pathology 先指研究疾病的科学，接着指疾病留下的改变、某一病程，最后泛指任何严重的社会毛病。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body map with one organ ringed in red.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张人体图上，一个器官被红笔圈出破损的地方。

branches.en: The science of disease is the founding sense.
branches.cn: 「病理学」是本义的学科义项。

branches.en: The lesion is the visible mark of that science.
branches.cn: 「病变」是这门学科所研究的可见痕迹。

branches.en: The course of one illness is the clinical sense.
branches.cn: 「某一病程的病理」是临床义项。

branches.en: Signs and symptoms are what pathology describes in practice.
branches.cn: 在实践中，病理学描述的正是症状与体征。

branches.en: A body lesion and a social ill share the idea of a fault.
branches.cn: 身体病变与社会病症共享「出了毛病」这一观念。

intro.en: Pathology joins the Greek combining form patho- with -logy, and suggests a whole family from pathogen to pathologist.
intro.cn: pathology 把希腊语组合成分 patho- 与 -logy 合在一起，由此衍生出从 pathogen 到 pathologist 的整个词族。

latinIntro.en: The parts are Greek, joined in Renaissance Latin as pathologia before giving English pathology.
latinIntro.cn: 这些成分来自希腊语，在文艺复兴时期的拉丁语中合成为 pathologia，再进入英语成为 pathology。

items.example: The form patho- starts many medical terms.
items.exampleCN: 组合成分 patho- 出现在许多医学术语开头。

items.example: The suffix -logy marks a science.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -logy 标记一门科学。

items.example: Latin pathologia carries the Greek -logia.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 pathologia 保留希腊语后缀 -logia。

items.example: The suffix -ical forms pathological.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ical 构成 pathological。

items.example: The suffix -ist forms pathologist.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ist 构成 pathologist。

items.example: A Greek prefix can set the field of study.
items.exampleCN: 希腊语前缀可以限定研究领域。

items.example: The figure of social disease yields such compounds.
items.exampleCN: 「社会病症」这一比喻产生了此类复合词。

items.example: Pathological describes what pathology examines.
items.exampleCN: pathological 描述病理学所考察的内容。

items.example: The root patho- also builds pathogen.
items.exampleCN: 词根 patho- 也构成 pathogen。

definition_zh: 小路；通道；途径；路径；路线
definition_en: a track or a set of connected steps that leads from one place, state, or goal to another
core_image: 草地上被人踩出的一条细径，从一个点一直通到另一个点
scene: 雨后的山腰上，一条石径从村口一直伸向远处的寺院。A narrow stone pathway led the walkers from the village gate to a quiet temple.
sceneCN: 这里 pathway 是「小路、通道」（第 1 个义项：供人或车辆行走的路线）；句意是：一条狭窄的石径把行人从村口引到一座安静的寺院。画面上可以看见湿滑的石板、两侧的青草和远处的屋檐。

derivatives.zh: 由 pathway 去掉表示「路」的名词成分 -way 得到的短形，表示小径、路径
pathway 加后缀 -based 构成的复合形容词，义为「基于路径的」
foot（脚）加 path（路）构成的复合词，指供人步行用的小径，与 pathway 同类

senses.title: A narrow walking track
senses.definition: a narrow route for walking, often one that is not a proper road
senses.definitionCN: 供人步行的狭窄路线，往往不是正式修筑的道路
senses.example: A stone pathway runs down to the river.
senses.exampleCN: 一条石径一直通到河边。
senses.why: The first half path means a track worn through the ground, and the second half way means a road or course, so the compound names a track arranged as a route.
senses.whyCN: 前半部分 path 指在地面上被踩出的痕迹，后半部分 way 指道路或路线；两半合起来，就把一条被踩出的痕迹写成了可以依循的路线，这是 pathway 最具体的画面。

senses.title: A protected corridor for people
senses.definition: an enclosed or marked passage between places, such as at a hospital or station
senses.definitionCN: 公共场所里被划定或围起来的通道，如医院或车站中的人行通道
senses.example: Emergency vehicles use a separate pathway behind the hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 救护车使用医院后面一条单独的车道。
senses.why: Once a route has to be built rather than worn, the physical track becomes a passage, and the word follows the scene from a field to a building.
senses.whyCN: 一旦路线要靠修筑而不是靠脚步踩出来，那条痕迹就变成了一条由人划定的通道；从野地换到楼内，但「把人从一处引到另一处」的结构没有变。

senses.title: A route in a network
senses.definition: a route along which signals, traffic, water, or energy travel
senses.definitionCN: 信号、车流、水流或能量在其中运行的路线
senses.example: The storm blocked the main pathway for buses into the city.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨堵塞了公交车进城的主要路径。
senses.why: Anything that flows needs a line of travel, and once the line carries something other than feet, the walkway turns into a transmission route.
senses.whyCN: 凡是流动之物都要有一条行进路线；当线上传递的不再是脚步而是电流、车流或水流时，供人行走的「路」就抽象成了传输的路线，而这条路线本身仍然可以被「堵住」。

senses.title: A chemical or biological route
senses.definition: a series of linked chemical reactions or steps inside a living cell
senses.definitionCN: 活细胞中一连串相互衔接的化学反应或步骤
senses.example: Vitamin B helps this metabolic pathway run faster.
senses.exampleCN: 维生素 B 能让这条代谢途径运行得更快。
senses.why: A pathway is a sequence of stations, and a chain of reactions is read as the same sequence of stations inside the body, so the word moves from the landscape to the cell.
senses.whyCN: pathway 本是一条串着若干站点的路；生化反应也是一串前后接续的站点，于是科学语言把这串反应当作体内的「路」来读，词义就从地貌挪进了细胞。

senses.title: A way of reaching a goal
senses.definition: a method or means by which a goal or problem can be approached
senses.definitionCN: 达到目标或处理问题所依靠的方法或手段
senses.example: Education is the surest pathway out of poverty.
senses.exampleCN: 教育是摆脱贫困最可靠的途径。
senses.why: If a track can lead to a temple, it can also lead to a goal, and the noun keeps the image of a line that ends at a destination.
senses.whyCN: 一条小路既然能通向寺院，也能通向人生目标；词义于是把「通向终点的线」保留下来，只是把地理上的终点换成了抽象的终点，道路随之成为方法。

senses.title: A planned course of study or work
senses.definition: an organised series of stages, such as courses or jobs, followed over time
senses.definitionCN: 按次序推进的一连串阶段，如课程或职业阶段
senses.example: The college offers a clear pathway from school to work.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学院提供了一条从校园通向职场的清晰路径。
senses.why: When the stages are strung together in time rather than in space, the way becomes a plan of stages, which is why careers and studies are described with this word.
senses.whyCN: 当这些站点不在空间上前后排开，而是在时间里依次推进时，「路」就变成了一份分段的计划；这正是生涯与学业规划借用 pathway 来表达的原因。

senses.title: A nerve route in the body
senses.definition: the route along which nerve signals travel in the body or brain
senses.definitionCN: 神经信号在身体或大脑中行进的路线
senses.example: Repeating an action strengthens the neural pathway behind it.
senses.exampleCN: 重复同一个动作会强化其背后的神经通路。
senses.why: Nerve fibres are literal lines of travel, so the most physical sense of the word sits naturally in the most physiological part of biology.
senses.whyCN: 神经纤维本身就是体内真实的「路」，所以 pathway 最具体的那层「可走的路」直接落在了生物学中最肉身的对象上，这也是它在医学语境里最常出现的用法。

senses.title: A route through a system
senses.definition: a defined route that information, goods, or a procedure follows through a system
senses.definitionCN: 信息、货物或程序在系统中必须遵循的规定路线
senses.example: The new software shortens the pathway for approving expenses.
senses.exampleCN: 这套新软件缩短了审批报销的流程路径。
senses.why: When an organisation decides in advance where things must go, the old image of a marked track becomes the decisive sense, and the word now names a rule about movement.
senses.whyCN: 当机构事先规定物品或信息必须怎么走时，那条「预先标好的路」就从自然痕迹变成了制度；pathway 在这里不只是描述路存在，而是规定路怎么走、不许绕行。

intro.en: Pathway joins path, an old English word for a track, with way, an old word for a road, so it has meant a route of travel since the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: pathway 由 path（古英语指小径）与 way（古道、路）合成，自十六世纪起就表示可供行走的路线。

items.en: Paeth gives English its word for a narrow track.
items.cn: paeth 提供了英语里表示狭窄小径的词。

items.en: Weg means a road or a course of travel.
items.cn: weg 意为道路或行程。

items.en: Path and way are joined into pathway, a travelled route.
items.cn: 两个词合为 pathway，表示行走的路线。

items.en: Garden designers use pathway for walks in parks and estates.
items.cn: 园林设计师用 pathway 指花园与庄园中的步道。

items.en: Anatomists use the word for the routes that carry nerve signals.
items.cn: 解剖学家开始用它指传递神经信号的路径。

items.en: The word now covers study routes, metabolic chains, and software flows.
items.cn: 现代英语中，它的范围扩展到学习路径、代谢链与软件流程。

note.en: Pathway is the double word for a route, standing beside path, way, and the more abstract course and channel.
note.cn: pathway 是把 path 与 way 合在一起的「路线」词，与 path、way 以及更抽象的 course、channel 相邻。

entries.definition: a narrow track for walking
entries.definitionCN: 小径；道路

entries.definition: tracks that lead through a place
entries.definitionCN: 穿行某处的多条小路

entries.definition: a path made for people walking
entries.definitionCN: 人行小径

entries.definition: a route or method of doing something
entries.definitionCN: 道路；方法

entries.definition: the way from one place to another
entries.definitionCN: 路线

entries.definition: a wide street or a way of doing something
entries.definitionCN: 大街；途径

normalIntro.en: Pathway keeps the plain English picture of a track, then widens it to any line of movement or progress.
normalIntro.cn: pathway 保留了英语里「小径」这一朴素的画面，再把它扩展到任何行进或进展的线。

normal.en: Pathway is path plus way, two old English words for a route.
normal.cn: pathway 由 path 与 way 合成，两者都是古英语表示路线的词。

normal.en: A career pathway is a set of steps toward a goal.
normal.cn: career pathway 是通往目标的一串步骤。

normal.en: A metabolic pathway chains reactions together.
normal.cn: metabolic pathway 把一串反应连在一起。

normal.en: The phrase a pathway to marks the destination the road leads to.
normal.cn: 搭配「a pathway to」标出这条路通向的目的地。

normal.en: Compare path, which is shorter and often physical, while pathway is common in science and planning.
normal.cn: 对比 path：path 更短、更偏具体，pathway 在科学与规划语境中更常见。

abstract.en: Picture a line of flat stones in wet grass, one stone after another.
abstract.cn: 想象湿草地上的一排石板，一块接一块。

abstract.en: Think of a corridor with signs pointing toward the exit.
abstract.cn: 想象一条挂着指向出口标牌的走廊。

abstract.en: Imagine traffic lights turning green in order, one after another.
abstract.cn: 想象红绿灯按顺序一个一个变绿。

examples.en: The gardeners laid a pathway between the rose beds.
examples.cn: 园丁在玫瑰花坛之间铺了一条小径。

examples.en: A good mentor can open a pathway into research for a young student.
examples.cn: 一位好导师能为年轻学生打开通向科研的途径。

examples.en: The researchers traced each metabolic pathway in the cells.
examples.cn: 研究人员追踪了细胞里的每一条代谢途径。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「帕斯威」——怕湿（帕斯）的一条路（威）：想象雨后怕湿脚，所以沿着一排石板走，就是一条小径。这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 paeth（小径）+ weg（路）→ 中古英语及近代英语 pathway（行走的路线）；两词均属日耳曼语来源，更早的原始印欧语重构形式存疑，此处不强行追溯。核心义「从一处通到另一处的线」。

sensesIntro.en: Pathway starts as a literal track under the feet, then becomes a passage, a flow of signals, a chain of reactions, and finally any organised route toward a goal.
sensesIntro.cn: pathway 从脚下真实的小径出发，依次扩展到建筑的通道、信号的流路、化学反应的链条，最后落到任何通往目标的规划路线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow line worn through the grass, joining one point to another.
core.cn: 核心意象：草地上被踩出的一条细线，把两个点连起来。

branches.en: The literal track in a garden or field is the ground sense.
branches.cn: 花园或田野里的实体小径是地面义项。

branches.en: A corridor and a traffic or signal line keep the route but change the traveller.
branches.cn: 建筑通道和车流、信号路线都保留了「路」，只换了在上面走的东西。

branches.en: Reactions and nerves are read as lines inside the body.
branches.cn: 反应链与神经都被读成体内的路线。

branches.en: A method and a career plan are routes toward a destination in time.
branches.cn: 方法与生涯规划是指向时间性终点的路线。

branches.en: A system route is the track written down as a rule.
branches.cn: 系统路径是被写成规则的那条路。

intro.en: Pathway is a native English compound of two nouns, path and way, and is built around by footpath, road and the shorter path.
intro.cn: pathway 是两个名词 path 与 way 组成的本土英语复合词，其周围还有 footpath、path 等词。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin root, because both halves come from Old English, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，两个部分都来自古英语，因此拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.example: Path is the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: path 是复合词的前半部分。

items.example: Way supplies the sense of a route.
items.exampleCN: way 提供「路线」的含义。

items.example: The element -way builds highway and railway.
items.exampleCN: 成分 -way 构成 highway 与 railway。

items.example: Pathway keeps both halves in one word.
items.exampleCN: pathway 把两个部分合进一个词。

items.example: Foot tells you who walks there.
items.exampleCN: foot 说明了在那条路上行走的人。

items.meaning: the part of a road used by vehicles
items.example: Roadway is built the same way as pathway.
items.exampleCN: roadway 与 pathway 的构词方式相同。

items.meaning: a course through space or life
items.example: Path now also means a course in life.
items.exampleCN: path 现在也指人生的道路。

items.example: Beware: pathological comes from a Greek root, not from path.
items.exampleCN: 注意：pathological 来自希腊语词根，与 path 无关，只是拼写相近。

items.example: Pathos is also Greek, so it is not a relative of path.
items.exampleCN: pathos 同样来自希腊语，与 path 不是同源词，只是拼写相近。
